Author: Rajeev Misra
Bench: Rajeev Misra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:18901
Court No. - 71
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42811 of 2024
Applicant :- Suraj Pal And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Nirbhay Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr.Nirbhay Singh, the learned counsel for applicants and the learned A.G.A. for State.

2. Perused the record.
3. Applicants-Suraj Pal And 4 Others, who are charge sheeted accused, have approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with the following prayer:-
"It is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to quash the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 25537 of 2023, State Versus Prakash and others Under Sections 376, 307, 313, 323, 506 IPC to the extents of the applicant no.4 and the applicant no.1,2,3 and 5 were summoned under sections 313, 323, 506 IPC Police Station Narkhi District Firozabad arising out of the Suraj Pal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160019960/
1 impugned charge sheet dated 14.07.2021 in connection with Case Crime No.49/2021,
Police Station Narkhi District Firozabad, as well as impugned cognizance order dated 21.07.2023 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Firozabad, So that justice may be done.
It is further prayed

entities.text: Suraj Pal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceeding of Criminal Case No. 25537 of 2023, State Versus Prakash and others Under Sections 376, 307, 313, 323, 506 IPC Police Station Narkhi District Firozabad arising out of the impugned charge sheet dated 14.07.2021 in connection with Case Crime No.49/2021, Police Station Narkhi District Firozabad, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Firozabad during the pendency of the present application before this Hon'ble Court, So that justice may be done

At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. submits that applicants have rushed to this Court by filing the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. without availing statutory remedy available under Section 227 Cr.
P.C. Learned A.G.A. further submits that Court below can deal with the grounds raised in support of this application threadbare at the first instance as it has the advantage of original record.

On the above premise, the learned A.G.A. submits that no interference is warranted by this Court in present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
5.
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicants could not overcome the same.

6. Having heard the learned counsel for applicants, the learned A.G.A. for State, and upon perusal of record, this Court finds that no useful purpose shall be served in keeping this application pending,
as the grounds raised by the learned counsel for applicants in support of this application can very well be examined by Court below meticulously at the time of deciding the discharge application as Court below has the advantage of having the original record.

7. Accordingly this application is disposed off finally with a direction to the applicants to approach Court below by filing a discharge application in terms of Section 227 Cr.P.C. seeking their discharge in above mentioned criminal case.

In case, such a discharge application is filed by applicants within a period of two weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order, the Court below shall proceed to decide the same by a reasoned and speaking order within a period of two months thereafter, provided there is no other legal impediment.
8. It goes without saying that till the disposal of discharge application as directed above, Court below shall not proceed further with the matter.
9. After aforesaid order was dictated the learned counsel for applicants submits that applicants have not yet been enlarged on bail.
In view of above, it is provided that applicants shall also file their bail applications before Court below alongwith discharge application.
Court below shall release the applicants on interim bail and thereafter, decide the discharge application filed by applicants on merits.

The interim bail granted to applicants by Court below shall come to an end immediately Suraj Pal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160019960/
2 upon passing of the order on the discharge application.
